description: Adopt HWAU as the generic weighted activity unit abstraction while preserving NWAU as Australian source terminology and compatibility alias.
completion_policy: Complete-with-gaps means HWAU is now the generic result terminology in the public result contract and runtime helper, while NWAU remains a compatibility alias for Australian source terminology. It does not claim every historical NWAU-named calculator column, package name, or adapter surface has been renamed.

implemented: Terminology rule that HWAU is the generic abstraction and NWAU remains Australian source terminology.
Runtime result normalizer that adds the missing HWAU/NWAU alias and rejects conflicts.
HTTP API and OpenAI adapter examples exposing `hwau` while preserving `nwau`.
not_implemented: Runtime alias coverage across every calculator and adapter.
Generated schema migration proof for all public contracts.
Deprecation rollout for every historical NWAU-named API.

gap_register.description: Runtime and schema-level alias tests now cover the shared result normalizer, HTTP API result schema, and public examples. Broader adapter-by-adapter rename/deprecation work remains out of scope for this archive.
gap_register.rationale: This closes the archive blocker without claiming a bulk rename of historical NWAU calculator columns or package identifiers.
